facts.text: Salterra is one of only two resorts on South Caicos.
facts.excerpt: As one of only two resorts on the island, the main draw is how uncrowded and close to nature it feels.

facts.text: South Caicos is a small fishing island off the main Turks and Caicos strip.
facts.excerpt: a small fishing island off the main Turks and Caicos strip

facts.text: Salterra sits on a nearly private stretch of beach on the island's southern edge.
facts.excerpt: Salterra sits on a nearly private stretch of beach on the island’s southern edge

facts.text: The resort's setting pairs clear turquoise waters and white sand beaches with jagged bluffs covered in tropical flora and fauna.
facts.excerpt: clear, turquoise waters meet white sand beaches, rising into jagged bluffs covered in unique tropical flora and fauna

facts.text: All rooms offer generous balconies and ocean-facing views.
facts.excerpt: All rooms offer generous balconies and ocean-facing views

facts.text: Ground-floor guestrooms feature private lanais that open directly to the beach landscape.
facts.excerpt: ground-floor guestrooms feature private lanais that open directly to the beach landscape

facts.text: The two Penthouse Suites sit atop the resort with panoramic ocean views, three bedrooms, a full kitchen and dedicated butler service.
facts.excerpt: our two Penthouse Suites sit atop the resort with panoramic ocean views and 2,800 square feet of elevated living. Featuring three bedrooms, a full kitchen, expansive indoor spaces, and dedicated butler service

facts.text: Rooms feature The Andrea Collection by Frette linens and the Le Chemin bath collection by Byredo.
facts.excerpt: Sink into the softness of The Andrea Collection by Frette—from linens to robes and slippers—crafted for comfort and elegance. Indulge in the exclusive Le Chemin bath collection by Byredo

facts.text: The resort's colour palette is pulled from a drone photo of the salt flats at sunset.
facts.excerpt: the colour palette is pulled directly from a drone photo of the salt flats at sunset

facts.text: The lobby's low-slung chairs are reminiscent of ancient Taino ceremonial chairs found in caves nearby.
facts.excerpt: the low-slung chairs in the lobby are reminiscent of ancient Taino ceremonial chairs

facts.text: The island's salt-harvesting past is the throughline for the resort's design and dining.
facts.excerpt: The island’s salt-harvesting past is the throughline for everything—from the choice of accent colors in the rooms to the stories you hear over a five-course dinner.

facts.text: The Spa at Salterra has an aquathermal circuit featuring a salt sauna and steam room.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a salt sauna and steam room, the aquathermal circuit is an immersive, experiential journey within the spa

facts.text: The spa's treatment journey draws on the restorative powers of salt and sea using natural and organic products.
facts.excerpt: The Salterra treatment journey draws on the restorative powers of salt and sea across a menu of grounding and revitalizing services, each crafted with natural and organic products.

facts.text: The spa has a dedicated spa pool, a hot tub, private treatment rooms and couples massage pavilions.
facts.excerpt: a dedicated spa pool with loungers and umbrellas, a hot tub, a steam room, and a salt sauna, alongside private treatment rooms and couples massage pavilions

facts.text: The spa is tucked into a quiet courtyard with whitewashed gables.
facts.excerpt: It’s tucked into a quiet courtyard with whitewashed gables, a private plunge pool, and scalloped striped umbrellas

facts.text: The lagoon-style pool lies at the heart of the resort, framed by palms and open sky.
facts.excerpt: At its heart lies our crown jewel—the lagoon-style pool—a tranquil oasis where the crystal-clear waters mirror the brilliant blues of the South Caicos sea. Framed by palms and open sky

facts.text: Beach and poolside cabanas come with a dedicated butler.
facts.excerpt: Experience ultimate luxury with our exclusive beach and poolside cabana service. Relax in privacy with a dedicated butler.

facts.text: Salterra has two dedicated pickleball courts.
facts.excerpt: Salterra features two dedicated pickleball courts, fully equipped with paddles ready for play.

facts.text: Brine, the signature fine dining restaurant, serves a five-course tasting menu with curated salt pairings and sommelier-selected wines.
facts.excerpt: At Brine, Salterra’s signature fine dining restaurant, our five-course tasting menu is a journey through the vitality of the island—complete with curated salt pairings and wines selected by our sommelier.

facts.text: Cobo Bar & Grill serves Latin-inspired cuisine overlooking the beach.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy Latin-inspired cuisine overlooking the beach with curated cocktails at our South Caicos bar and restaurant.

facts.text: Adventures by Salterra is the resort's entirely in-house excursions program.
facts.excerpt: Through Adventures by Salterra, our entirely in-house excursions...See More program

facts.text: Guests can snorkel among eagle rays in the Caicos Bank and paddle to uninhabited cays.
facts.excerpt: Experience South Caicos snorkeling among eagle rays in the vibrant Caicos Bank, paddle to uninhabited cays, or discover hidden coves

facts.text: The Salinas, once the heart of South Caicos' salt industry, attract flamingos, herons and egrets.
facts.excerpt: Flamingos, herons, and egrets can often be seen wading through the still waters

facts.text: Guests can join a coral restoration expedition starting at the School for Field Studies' coral lab.
facts.excerpt: guests can join a full coral restoration expedition. Starting at the School for Field Studies’ coral lab

facts.text: Salterra offers complimentary yoga classes.
facts.excerpt: Begin your day with our complimentary yoga classes

facts.text: Two floating platforms are anchored just offshore, a short knee-deep walk into the ocean.
facts.excerpt: one of two floating platforms anchored just offshore. They’re a short, knee-deep walk in the ocean

facts.text: Salterra Kids is a kids club for ages 4-12 with activities such as hands-on marine conservation and nature-inspired crafts.
facts.excerpt: Our beachfront hotel's Kids Club for ages 4–12 blends island adventure with purposeful play—from hands‑on marine conservation to nature‑inspired crafts.

facts.text: Suites have butlers that guests can message on WhatsApp.
facts.excerpt: Suites have butlers, who you can message on WhatsApp for anything you need.

facts.text: Free beach cruiser bikes at the hotel entrance can take guests a few minutes into Cockburn Harbor.
facts.excerpt: grabbing one of the free beach cruiser bikes in the hotel entrance and pedaling a few minutes into Cockburn Harbor

facts.text: Providenciales is a separate island, not accessible to South Caicos by car; guests flying there connect via a short scenic flight.
facts.excerpt: Guests may also fly into Providenciales (PLS) and connect via a short scenic flight. Please note: Providenciales is a separate island, not accessible to South Caicos by car.

facts.text: South Caicos is quiet, without a downtown or a cruise port.
facts.excerpt: is quiet, without a downtown or a cruise port

facts.text: Most guests do not come for thriving nightlife or a long list of dining options.
facts.excerpt: Most people don’t come here looking for thriving nightlife or a long list of dining options, though.

facts.text: Salterra's sustainability efforts include solar-powered energy, composting and the elimination of single-use plastics.
facts.excerpt: From solar-powered energy and composting initiatives to the elimination of single-use plastics
